editorial:
Imagine the most stressed-out bodyguard in the world being forced to work with a loud-mouthed hitman and his even crazier wife. That is exactly what you get here. You will see Michael Bryce, who just wants to follow the rules, getting dragged into a wild mess by Darius and Sonia Kincaid. The vibe is like a non-stop ride on a rollercoaster where everything that can go wrong does go wrong. It is less about a deep plot and more about the funny bickering between these three characters who absolutely cannot stand each other but have to work together to survive.

The action is loud and colorful, and the chemistry between the actors is what really makes it work. While the plot can feel a bit messy at times, the fast pace keeps you from getting bored. If you love movies that do not take themselves too seriously, you will have a blast. To get the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the explosions clearly, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a huge fight against the villain, Jason King. After a chaotic battle involving a lot of gunfire and explosions, the trio manages to take him down for good. Bryce finally accepts that he can never have a normal, quiet life. He ends up working with the Kincaids as a team, realizing that being a bodyguard for the world's most dangerous couple is actually a lot of fun.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves loud action and buddy comedies.
